comment:
**Verify that setup provisions the fixed model directory.**

If `/private/tmp/neurobrain-qwen35-4b-mlx` does not exist, `mlx-lm==0.32.2` passes that absolute path to `snapshot_download` instead of finding a model elsewhere. Generation then depends on resolving that path as a Hub repository. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/v0.32.2/mlx_lm/utils.py))

Does the repository's model-conversion setup create this exact directory? Check the setup at the reviewed revision. If it does not, accept a model path or repository ID as an argument. Otherwise, users with the model stored elsewhere cannot regenerate these answers without editing the script or recreating the fixed directory.
